sources.name: CONAE SAOCOM L-band SAR catalogue
sources.description: Argentine SAOCOM-1A/1B L-band SAR data catalogue (all polarisations, StripMap/TOPSAR) for institutional and research users; free registration, projects may require approval. Includes Argentine optical SAC-D/SAC-C archives.

sources.name: ALOS PALSAR Radiometrically Terrain Corrected products (ASF)
sources.description: Gamma0 RTC GeoTIFFs with DEM-based terrain correction for ALOS-1 PALSAR (2006-2011), 12.5 m or 30 m, at ASF. Free Earthdata Login required.

sources.name: Austria Open Government Data - ALS and orthophotos (data.gv.at, basemap.at)
sources.description: Austria's open data catalogue with 1 m DGM (ALS) across states, orthophotos, basemap.at WMTS service and Landsat/Sentinel-derived products. Open, no login for most datasets.

sources.name: Bureau of Meteorology (Australia) satellite imagery
sources.description: Real-time Himawari-9 true colour, infrared and water-vapour imagery of Australia and the Asia-Pacific region with animation; archived full-disk Himawari data available on AWS (NCI). View is open.

sources.name: Digital Earth Africa
sources.description: Operational Open Data Cube service giving free analysis-ready Landsat, Sentinel-1/2, DEM and derived products (water, crop, fractional cover, mangroves) across Africa. Data are open on S3 and via a public STAC API; Sandbox notebooks need free sign-up.

sources.name: ELVIS Elevation and Depth - Foundation Spatial Data (Australia)
sources.description: Australia's national lidar and DEM portal (ELVIS): 5 m DEM, point clouds and 1 m DEMs from state/federal surveys; free orders emailed as download links; no payment, anonymous.

sources.name: Digital Earth Australia
sources.description: Geoscience Australia's national analysis-ready EO program: Landsat and Sentinel-2 surface reflectance, water observations, fractional cover and coastlines for Australia back to 1987. Open data on S3, accessible via STAC, OWS and the DEA Maps viewer.

sources.name: Digitaal Vlaanderen (Flanders) - orthophotos and DHMV lidar
sources.description: Flemish open orthophoto (OMW, 25 cm) and Digital Elevation Model Flanders (DHMV II, 1 m, point clouds) with historical imagery; available as download and OGC services. No login.

sources.name: INPE Image Catalog (CBERS, Amazonia-1, Landsat, Sentinel, Terra/Aqua)
sources.description: Free catalogue of CBERS-2/2B/4/4A, Amazonia-1, Landsat, Terra/Aqua and Resourcesat imagery for Brazil and global coverage at 2-64 m. Free registration for download; STAC also available.

sources.name: TerraBrasilis (PRODES, DETER deforestation monitoring)
sources.description: Deforestation and fire monitoring portal for the Amazon, Cerrado and other Brazilian biomes with PRODES and DETER vector maps, WMS/WFS and downloads. Open.

sources.name: Copernicus Climate Change Service Climate Data Store (CDS)
sources.description: ERA5 reanalysis and satellite climate data records (soil moisture, sea ice, albedo, LAI, surface radiation, fire, ocean colour) with API and web UI. Free registration.

sources.name: CanElevation Series (HRDEM, CDEM, CDSM) - Natural Resources Canada
sources.description: National elevation data for Canada: High Resolution DEM (1-2 m from lidar), Canadian Digital Elevation Model and CDSM with STAC and WCS/WMS access. Open Government Licence, no login.

sources.name: CSA Earth Observation Data Management System (EODMS)
sources.provider: Canadian Space Agency / Natural Resources Canada
sources.description: Federal Canadian EO archive: RADARSAT-1/2, RADARSAT Constellation Mission (RCM), SPOT, Landsat, Sentinel and airborne data. Search/browse open; free registration for downloads; some RADARSAT-2 restricted.

sources.name: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service Atmosphere Data Store (ADS)
sources.description: Global and European atmospheric composition forecasts and reanalyses (EAC4, aerosol, ozone, NO2, GHG) assimilating satellite data. Free registration, API access.

sources.name: ICGC (Institut Cartografic i Geologic de Catalunya) open data - orthophotos and lidar
sources.provider: Institut Cartografic i Geologic de Catalunya
sources.description: Catalan mapping agency open data: orthophotos (25 cm, historical since 1945), lidar and Sentinel-2 mosaic products, delivered via download and WMS/WMTS. No login for open licences.

sources.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
sources.description: Primary open archive for Copernicus Sentinel-1/2/3/5P data (replacing the Copernicus Open Access Hub), plus Contributing Missions, Copernicus DEM and Landsat copies. Offers OData, OpenSearch, STAC, S3 and Sentinel Hub APIs; a free account is required for downloads.

sources.name: CEOS Open Data Cube and Analysis Ready Data
sources.description: Information on CEOS Analysis Ready Data for Land (CARD4L) standards and Open Data Cube deployments that serve ready-to-use Landsat, Sentinel and SAR data in several countries (Australia, Africa, Switzerland, Vietnam, Colombia). Open documentation.

sources.name: swisstopo geodata (SWISSIMAGE, swissALTI3D, swissSURFACE3D)
sources.description: Swiss open orthoimagery (SWISSIMAGE 10 cm, historical), 0.5 m DEM and lidar point clouds, free since 2021 via STAC API and downloads. No login.

sources.name: CIRA/RAMMB SLIDER (Satellite Loop Interactive Data Explorer in Real-time)
sources.provider: Colorado State University CIRA / NOAA NESDIS RAMMB
sources.description: Zoomable, full-resolution viewer of GOES-East/West, Himawari, GK-2A, Meteosat and JPSS imagery with all bands and RGB composites, time looping and download of frames. Open, no login.

sources.name: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS)
sources.description: Pan-European and global land cover, CORINE, HRL, Urban Atlas, imperviousness, NDVI/LAI/FAPAR, snow & ice, Copernicus DEM-related datasets and the Copernicus Global Land Service. Open downloads; login for bulk.

sources.name: Copernicus Marine Service (CMEMS) Data Store
sources.description: Satellite and model ocean products: SST, sea level, ocean colour, sea ice, waves and winds, global and regional. Subset, download and Python toolbox; free account required.

sources.name: CASEarth Data Sharing and Service Portal
sources.provider: Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) Big Earth Data Science Engineering Program
sources.description: CAS Big Earth Data platform sharing global satellite-derived datasets (land cover, vegetation, surface water, forest cover, DEM-derived products) and CAS satellite imagery. Registration required for downloads.

sources.name: CRESDA China Centre for Resources Satellite Data and Application
sources.provider: China Centre for Resources Satellite Data and Application (CRESDA)
sources.description: Official distribution of Chinese resource satellites: GF-1/2/4/5/6/7 (Gaofen), ZY-1, ZY-3, ZY-02C, HJ-1, CBERS and more, with catalogue search. Interface is mostly Chinese; registration and often approval required.
tags: 中国资源卫星应用中心
sources.notes: Site blocks automated fetches (HTTP 403); not confirmed.

sources.name: China Geodata Cloud (地理空间数据云)
sources.description: Chinese mirror and distribution site for Landsat, ASTER GDEM, SRTM, MODIS, Sentinel and other open satellite datasets with registration; interface in Chinese with an English page.

sources.name: NSMC FengYun Satellite Data Center
sources.provider: National Satellite Meteorological Center, China Meteorological Administration
sources.description: Chinese FengYun (FY-2/3/4) meteorological satellite data: AGRI, MERSI, VIRR, MWRI, GIIRS etc. with real-time imagery and archive download after free registration; English interface is available.

sources.name: Tianditu (National Platform for Common GeoSpatial Information Services)
sources.provider: National Administration of Surveying, Mapping and Geoinformation of China (NASG)
sources.description: China's national online map service with satellite imagery, vector and terrain layers, WMTS services requiring a free developer key. Interface mainly Chinese.
sources.notes: Site blocks automated fetches (HTTP 418); not confirmed.

sources.name: Copernicus Contributing Missions (VHR and other)
sources.description: Very high resolution commercial and national mission archives (Pleiades, SPOT, WorldView, Planet, TerraSAR-X, COSMO-SkyMed, KOMPSAT etc.) available to eligible Copernicus users via CDSE and ESA. Access by user group approval.

sources.name: Copernicus DEM (GLO-30 / GLO-90)
sources.description: Global digital surface model derived from TanDEM-X (2011-2015) at 30 m and 90 m; GLO-30 is openly available as COG on AWS and via CDSE, GLO-90 is public everywhere. Open.

sources.name: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (EMS) Rapid Mapping
sources.description: On-demand rapid mapping products (delineation, grading, reference maps) for disasters worldwide, built from satellite imagery; archive of activations with downloadable vector and map products. Open.

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-1 (C-band SAR)
sources.description: C-band SAR constellation (Sentinel-1A/C operational; 1B lost 2021) with GRD, SLC and OCN products at 5-40 m, 6-12 day repeat. Free via CDSE, ASF, AWS; Sentinel-1D launched 2025.

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 (MSI)
sources.description: 13-band multispectral imager at 10/20/60 m, 5-day revisit with two satellites (2A/2B/2C); L1C TOA and L2A surface reflectance. Free via CDSE, AWS Earth Search, Planetary Computer and others.

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-3 and Sentinel-5P
sources.description: Sentinel-3 OLCI/SLSTR/SRAL ocean, land colour and temperature (300 m-1 km) and Sentinel-5P TROPOMI atmospheric composition (5.5x3.5 km). Via CDSE, EUMETSAT Data Store; free registration.

sources.name: CUZK Geoportal (Czechia) - orthophotos and DMR 5G lidar
sources.provider: Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre (CUZK)
sources.description: Czech national open data: orthophoto (12.5 cm), Digital Terrain Model of the Czech Republic 5th generation (DMR 5G) from airborne laser scanning, and historical orthophotos. Download without login.

sources.name: BKG Germany orthophotos (DOP) and DGM data via geoportal.de / BKG
sources.provider: Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG)
sources.description: Germany's federal geodata centre: DOP40/DOP20 digital orthophotos, DGM elevation, ATKIS and Sentinel-2 composites; many products now open under CC BY 4.0 with WMS/WMTS. State agencies hold the 20 cm data.

sources.name: DLR EOC Geoservice
sources.provider: German Aerospace Center (DLR) Earth Observation Center
sources.description: DLR portal for EO data downloads: TanDEM-X 90 m DEM, Global Urban Footprint, World Settlement Footprint, TerraSAR-X archive browse, DESIS, Sentinel, Landsat time series and several mosaics. Free registration for most.

sources.name: DLR EOWEB GeoPortal
sources.description: Order portal for DLR missions: TerraSAR-X, TanDEM-X (science proposals), RapidEye, DESIS, EnMAP, TET-1 and more, with catalogue search and proposal submission. Registration and proposal approval required for most data.

sources.name: TanDEM-X 90 m DEM (DLR)
sources.description: Global 90 m (3 arc-second) digital elevation model from the TanDEM-X mission, free for science after registration at the DLR EOC Geoservice. Delivered as 1x1 degree GeoTIFF tiles.

sources.name: World Settlement Footprint (WSF) datasets (DLR)
sources.description: Global 10 m settlement extent (WSF2019), 30 m evolution 1985-2015 and 3D (building) layers from Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat. Viewable and downloadable from the DLR Geoservice; registration for download.

sources.name: EnMAP Data Access Portal
sources.description: Data portal for the German EnMAP hyperspectral mission (30 m, 230 bands 420-2450 nm) with archive search, tasking proposals and L1B/L1C/L2A downloads. Free registration; GeoTIFF/COG per band and NetCDF.

sources.name: TanDEM-X Science Service (DLR)
sources.description: Proposal-based access for scientific use of TerraSAR-X and TanDEM-X SAR data (StripMap, ScanSAR, SpotLight, bistatic). Submit proposals through the portal; free data allocations after peer review.

sources.name: Dataforsyningen (Denmark) - Danish orthophotos and DHM terrain model
sources.provider: Danish Agency for Climate Data / SDFI
sources.description: Danish open data: GeoDanmark orthophotos (12.5 cm), Danmarks Hojdemodel (DHM/Terraen, DHM/Overflade, point clouds 4/m2), historical maps and photos; free access via token, WMS/WMTS/WCS and downloads.

sources.name: Estonian Land Board (Maa-amet) geoportal - orthophotos and ALS data
sources.description: Open orthophotos (historic from 1940s), lidar point clouds and DEMs of Estonia, downloadable and as WMS/WMTS. No login for open data.

sources.name: CNIG Centro de Descargas and PNOA (Spain)
sources.description: Spanish national download centre: PNOA orthophotos (25-50 cm), historical flights, PNOA-LiDAR point clouds and MDT elevation. Open CC BY 4.0, no login; also IDEE WMS/WMTS services.

sources.name: ESA Biomass (P-band SAR)
sources.description: P-band SAR mission launched April 2025 mapping forest biomass and height; data distributed via ESA's MAAP and Earth Online with registration. Early products 2025-2026.

sources.name: ESA CCI Open Data Portal
sources.description: Single entry point to all ESA CCI essential-climate-variable datasets, including the cryosphere ECVs (ice sheets, sea ice, glaciers, permafrost, snow). NetCDF via the CEDA archive and an OpenSearch/OPeNDAP-capable catalogue; no login.

links.label: ESA Climate Change Initiative Open Data Portal

sources.name: ESA CryoSat-2 data
sources.description: SAR/interferometric radar altimeter products for ice sheet elevation, sea-ice freeboard and ocean heights (2010-present); L1b/L2 swath and gridded data via ESA Science Server. Registration required.

sources.name: ESA Earth Online
sources.description: ESA's gateway to Earth observation missions, instruments and data access, including heritage (ERS, Envisat), Earth Explorers and Third Party Missions. Links to every ESA EO data access route; registration needed for many.

sources.name: ESA/JAXA EarthCARE
sources.description: Cloud-aerosol-radiation mission (launched May 2024) with cloud profiling radar, atmospheric lidar, multispectral imager and broadband radiometer. L1/L2 data via ESA Earth Online and JAXA G-Portal.

sources.name: ESA heritage missions archive (ERS-1/2 and Envisat)
sources.description: Reprocessed ERS-1/2 SAR/AMI/ATSR/altimeter (1991-2011) and Envisat ASAR, MERIS, AATSR, MIPAS, SCIAMACHY (2002-2012). Access via ESA Earth Online data catalogue, with free registration.

sources.name: Proba-V and PROBA-1 CHRIS data
sources.description: Proba-V (2013-2020) 100 m-1 km vegetation imagery and Proba-1 CHRIS hyperspectral and HRC imagery, via ESA Earth Online and the VITO Terrascope platform. Registration required.

sources.name: ESA SMOS (Soil Moisture and Ocean Salinity)
sources.description: L-band interferometric radiometer providing global soil moisture and ocean salinity data since 2009, brightness temperature at ~43 km. Access via ESA Earth Online, CATDS and BEC; registration needed.

sources.name: ESA Third Party Missions (TPM)
sources.description: ESA-distributed data from over 50 non-ESA missions (Landsat, SPOT, Pleiades, WorldView, RapidEye, TerraSAR-X, PlanetScope, etc.) under proposals for research use. Access via ESA user registration and proposal approval.

sources.name: ESA WorldCover
sources.description: Global 10 m land cover maps for 2020 and 2021 derived from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2, 11 classes. Download tiles as COG from AWS or via the viewer; also in Planetary Computer and Earth Engine.

sources.name: EUMETSAT CM SAF (Climate Monitoring Satellite Application Facility)
sources.description: Climate data records of cloud, radiation, water vapour and surface albedo derived from Meteosat, AVHRR and other sensors, via the Web User Interface. Free registration.

sources.name: EUMETSAT Data Store
sources.description: Archive and API for Meteosat (MSG SEVIRI, MTG FCI/LI), Metop, Sentinel-3, Sentinel-6 and Copernicus atmosphere/ocean products. Free registration; access via Data Store web UI, API and eumdac client.

sources.name: EUMETSAT Ocean and Sea Ice SAF
sources.description: Sea ice concentration/edge/type/drift, sea surface temperature, radiative fluxes and winds from AVHRR, SSMIS, AMSR2, ASCAT and geostationary imagers. Open access via FTP/THREDDS/OPeNDAP.

sources.name: EUMETView
sources.description: Web map and OGC WMS/WMTS for Meteosat and Copernicus near-real-time image products (natural colour, dust, fog, fires), browse only.

sources.name: Finnish National Land Survey (NLS) file service - orthophotos and laser scanning
sources.description: Open data (CC BY 4.0): national orthophotos (0.5 m), laser scanning point clouds, DEM 2 m and 10 m, historical aerial photos; File Service and OGC APIs with free API key.

sources.name: CNES GEODES (Geoscience Data Exchange Service)
sources.description: CNES's new portal to French-led space data such as SWOT, Pleiades-derived, Sentinel-2 L2A (MAJA), Venus, SPOT World Heritage, GEOSCIENCE data via a unified STAC-based search. Registration for download.

sources.name: THEIA Land Data Centre (CNES)
sources.provider: CNES / French land data hub THEIA
sources.description: French national hub for land surface products: Sentinel-2 L2A MAJA, OSO land cover, Landsat-8 time series, Pleiades and SPOT Maps, Muscate processing. Open products via the catalogue and STAC.

sources.name: IGN Geoplateforme (Geoportail) France
sources.provider: Institut national de l'information geographique et forestiere (IGN)
sources.description: Open orthophotos (BD ORTHO 20 cm, historical), LiDAR HD point clouds and MNT/RGE ALTI elevation for France and overseas, as WMS, WMTS, WFS and downloads. Open under Licence Ouverte.

sources.name: GEBCO Gridded Bathymetry Data
sources.description: Global 15 arc-second (~450 m) elevation grid covering land and seabed, updated yearly (GEBCO_2024/2025); downloadable as NetCDF/GeoTIFF/ESRI ASCII with WMS. Open, no login.

sources.name: BRIN Indonesia EO Data (LAPAN legacy: LAPAN-A2/A3, Landsat reception)
sources.provider: Indonesian National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN)
sources.description: BRIN research data repository successor of LAPAN's Remote Sensing Data Center, holding Indonesian EO archives and reception of Landsat/Sentinel/Terra/Aqua over Indonesia; access by request/registration. Landing page verified, data coverage varies.

sources.name: ISRO Bhuvan
sources.description: India's geoportal with satellite imagery, thematic maps, Bhuvan 2D/3D viewer, Cartosat/Resourcesat data browse, disaster services and WMS/WMTS layers. Viewing is open; many downloads need registration.

sources.name: MOSDAC (Meteorological and Oceanographic Satellite Data Archival Centre)
sources.description: Data from INSAT-3D/3DR/3DS, Kalpana, Oceansat, SCATSAT-1, MeghaTropiques, SARAL/AltiKa and other Indian satellites; browse, live Insat imagery and free-registration downloads of L1-L3 products.

sources.name: NRSC Open EO Data Archive (NOEDA) and Bhoonidhi
sources.description: Bhoonidhi (successor to NDC/NOEDA) is ISRO's EO data portal for Resourcesat-2/2A, Cartosat-1/2/3, RISAT, Oceansat, Landsat and other data; archive search free, downloads need registration with open and restricted products.

sources.name: VEDAS (Visualisation of Earth observation Data and Archival System)
sources.description: SAC web portal to visualise and analyse Indian EO derived geoproducts: land cover, vegetation indices, hazard, ocean, coastal and EO imagery layers with online processing. Mostly open.

sources.name: ASI COSMO-SkyMed Open Data and Science data portal
sources.description: COSMO-SkyMed X-band SAR constellation (and Second Generation) with a small open data programme and proposal-based science access; the ASI portal lists the open-data portal route. Access via ASI/Italian-Space-Agency approval.

sources.name: ASI PRISMA hyperspectral mission portal
sources.description: PRISMA hyperspectral imager (2019-) with 239 bands 400-2500 nm at 30 m plus 5 m panchromatic; L0-L2 products in HDF5. Free registration, data requested through a catalogue with ASI approval for some uses.

sources.name: Geoportale Nazionale (Italy) - Ministero dell'Ambiente
sources.provider: Ministero dell'Ambiente e della Sicurezza Energetica
sources.description: Italian national geoportal with WMS services of orthophotos (AGEA, IGM), terrain models (TINITALY, 10 m DEM) and thematic layers; many datasets open for download. Part Italian-language.

sources.name: JAXA ALOS-4 (DAICHI-4) PALSAR-3
sources.description: L-band SAR satellite (launched July 2024) PALSAR-3 with wide-swath (up to 200 km) imaging at 3 m resolution for disaster response and mapping. Data distributed via JAXA, Tellus and commercial resellers; mission information is open.

sources.name: JAXA ALOS PALSAR/PALSAR-2 global mosaics and ScanSAR
sources.description: Annual 25 m global L-band mosaics and forest/non-forest maps from ALOS PALSAR and ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 (2007-2010, 2015-present), plus ScanSAR wide-area products. Open download after simple registration.

sources.name: ALOS World 3D (AW3D30) global DSM
sources.description: Free 30 m (1 arc-second) global digital surface model from ALOS PRISM stereo (2006-2011); versions up to v4.1. Tiles downloadable after registration; also on Earth API and Planetary Computer.

sources.name: JAXA Earth API and Earth Observation Data Search
sources.description: Web API/JavaScript and Python library with STAC catalogue for JAXA-derived raster data (GSMaP, ALOS DSM, ALOS PALSAR mosaics, GCOM-C products, land cover). Open, no login.

sources.name: JAXA GCOM-C SGLI products
sources.description: GCOM-C/SGLI multispectral (250 m-1 km) global ocean, land and atmosphere products since 2018: vegetation, SST, chlorophyll, snow, aerosol. Free registration at G-Portal; browse of images open.

sources.name: GOSAT Data Archive Service (GDAS)
sources.provider: National Institute for Environmental Studies (NIES), Japan
sources.description: GOSAT and GOSAT-2 greenhouse-gas (CO2, CH4) spectrometer data and TANSO-CAI imagery with L1-L4 products. Free registration required.

sources.name: JAXA G-Portal (AMSR2, GCOM-C sea ice and polar products)
sources.description: JAXA's search and download portal for GCOM-W AMSR2 and GCOM-C SGLI, GOSAT and other Earth observation products, including sea ice concentration and polar brightness temperatures. Free account required for downloads.

sources.name: GSI Maps and Geospatial Information Authority of Japan imagery
sources.description: Japan's national map portal: seamless orthophotos, historic aerial photography (1940s onward), relief, disaster-response imagery and tiled XYZ services. Free to view; tiles use the GSI terms of use.

sources.name: JAXA GSMaP Global Satellite Mapping of Precipitation
sources.description: Hourly 0.1 degree global precipitation maps from GPM and constellation passive-microwave radiometers, near-real-time and standard products. Download after registration; realtime viewer open.

sources.name: JAXA Himawari Monitor (P-Tree)
sources.description: Near-real-time Himawari-8/9 products (aerosol, cloud, shortwave radiation, SST) and imagery with FTP distribution after free P-Tree registration. Viewers are open.

sources.name: JMA Himawari-8/9 imagery
sources.description: JMA Meteorological Satellite Center page for Himawari-8/9 AHI (16 bands, 10 min, 0.5-2 km) real-time imagery, band-by-band images and information on data access (HimawariCloud, HimawariCast). Open images.

sources.name: KARI KOMPSAT satellite image portal (KOMPSAT-3/5 open data)
sources.description: KOMPSAT-1/2/3/3A/5/7 archives (optical 0.4-1 m, X-band SAR) catalogued in Korea's Satellite Information Application Centre, with free-registration open-data search for research. Interface in Korean with English option.

sources.name: KMA GK-2A (GEO-KOMPSAT-2A) AMI imagery and National Meteorological Satellite Center
sources.description: Geostationary AMI imagery (16 channels, 10 min, 0.5-2 km) from GK-2A with real-time viewers and archive data via the NMSC data service; free registration for downloads.

sources.name: NGII Korea National Geographic Information Institute (orthoimagery and DEM)
sources.description: National mapping agency of Korea: digital topographic maps, orthophotos and elevation data via the National Spatial Data Infrastructure portal; some via Open Data. Registration required for many products.

sources.name: USGS Landsat Collection 2 on AWS/Planetary Computer (Landsat C2 L2)
sources.description: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance and temperature served as COGs via STAC on Microsoft Planetary Computer, no login for metadata and SAS-signed asset access.

sources.name: INEGI Mexico - Mapa Digital, satellite imagery and Continuo de Elevaciones Mexicano
sources.provider: Instituto Nacional de Estadistica y Geografia (INEGI)
sources.description: Mexico's national statistics and geography institute: ortophotos, SPOT/Landsat mosaics, CEM elevation (15 m, 5 m, lidar), topographic map downloads. Free, some via portal navigator.

sources.name: NASA ASDC (Atmospheric Science Data Center, Langley DAAC)
sources.description: DAAC for atmospheric composition, radiation budget and clouds: CERES, MISR, MOPITT, CALIPSO, TEMPO, plus airborne campaigns. HDF/NetCDF products; Earthdata Login for download.

sources.name: ASF DAAC (Alaska Satellite Facility)
sources.description: NASA's SAR data center: Sentinel-1, ALOS PALSAR, RADARSAT-1, ERS-1/2, JERS-1, Seasat, UAVSAR, SMAP, NISAR and OPERA. Search via Vertex; free Earthdata Login for downloads; HyP3 on-demand processing.
sources.notes: Site blocks automated fetches (HTTP 403); not confirmed.

sources.name: ASTER (Terra) L1T and Global DEM
sources.provider: NASA LP DAAC / METI / JAXA Earth Remote Sensing Data Analysis Center
sources.description: Terra ASTER 15 m VNIR, 30 m SWIR, 90 m TIR scenes (2000-present; SWIR lost 2008) plus ASTER GDEM v3 30 m. Via LP DAAC/Earthdata Search with login; ASTER Volcano Archive also available.

sources.name: NASA AVIRIS and AVIRIS-NG airborne imaging spectrometer
sources.description: Airborne visible/shortwave infrared imaging spectrometer data (AVIRIS-Classic, AVIRIS-NG, AVIRIS-3), 224-285 bands 380-2510 nm, flight-line scenes at 1-20 m. Open data portal with search map; no login for download.

sources.name: NASA Common Metadata Repository (CMR) API
sources.description: Metadata catalog and search API (granules, collections, variables, services, STAC and OpenSearch front-ends) behind Earthdata Search and all DAACs. Searching requires no login; data download does.

sources.name: NASA Earth Observatory image library
sources.description: Curated, georeferenced natural-colour and false-colour satellite images (Landsat, MODIS, VIIRS, Sentinel, ISS) with story context and downloadable large JPEG/GeoTIFF versions. Open; processed for visual interpretation, not calibrated data.

sources.name: NASA Earthdata Cloud (AWS-hosted DAAC archives)
sources.description: NASA's migration of DAAC archives to AWS us-west-2 so users can analyse data in place via S3 direct access. Documents the cloud collections and the temporary-credential access pattern; requires Earthdata Login.

sources.name: NASA Earthdata Search
sources.description: Primary search and download interface for NASA Earth science data held in the CMR across all DAACs, with spatial/temporal filters, granule browse and subsetting. Free Earthdata Login is required for downloads, not for searching.

sources.name: NASA ECOSTRESS (ISS thermal infrared radiometer)
sources.description: Thermal infrared land surface temperature and evapotranspiration at ~70 m from the ISS since 2018, distributed through LP DAAC. Earthdata Login required.

sources.name: NASA EMIT (ISS imaging spectrometer)
sources.description: Earth Surface Mineral Dust Source Investigation on the ISS (60 m, 285 bands 380-2500 nm). L1B/L2A/L2B reflectance, mineralogy and methane plume data are served by LP DAAC and the EMIT open-data portal.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS
sources.description: Fire Information for Resource Management System: active-fire detections from MODIS, VIIRS and Landsat in near-real time, with web map, WMS and downloadable shapefile/CSV. Anonymous browsing; free API key for bulk access.

sources.name: GEDI (Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation) lidar
sources.description: Full-waveform lidar on the ISS (2019-2023, resumed 2024) giving 25 m footprint canopy height, structure and biomass from 51.6 N/S. L1-L4 products at LP DAAC and ORNL DAAC; Earthdata Login required.

sources.name: NASA GES DISC (Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center)
sources.description: DAAC for atmospheric composition, precipitation (TRMM, GPM IMERG), hydrology (GLDAS, NLDAS), MERRA-2 reanalysis, AIRS, OMI and OCO-2. NetCDF/HDF with OPeNDAP, subsetting and Giovanni visualisation; Earthdata Login for download.

sources.name: NASA GHRC DAAC (Global Hydrometeorology Resource Center)
sources.provider: NASA MSFC / University of Alabama in Huntsville
sources.description: DAAC for lightning, severe storms and hydrometeorology: LIS/OTD, GLM, TRMM/GPM ground validation and airborne field-campaign data. Mostly NetCDF/HDF; Earthdata Login for download.

sources.name: NASA GIBS (Global Imagery Browse Services)
sources.description: Tile services (WMTS, TMS, WMS) delivering daily global browse imagery from hundreds of NASA science products, including MODIS, VIIRS, ASTER, Landsat, SMAP and AIRS, in several projections including polar. The documentation lists endpoints, layer IDs and time dimensions.

sources.name: NASA Harmony (cloud subsetting and reformatting)
sources.description: Earthdata Cloud API that subsets by spatial/variable/time and reformats granules (e.g. to GeoTIFF/NetCDF/PNG) on the fly. Requires Earthdata Login.

sources.name: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS) v2
sources.description: 30 m surface reflectance combining Landsat 8/9 OLI (HLSL30) and Sentinel-2 MSI (HLSS30) on a common grid in Sentinel-2 MGRS tiling, 2-3 day revisit. Cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs in Earthdata Cloud; login required.

sources.name: NASA LAADS DAAC (Level-1 and Atmosphere Archive and Distribution System)
sources.description: Authoritative archive of MODIS (Terra/Aqua), VIIRS (S-NPP, NOAA-20/21), Black Marble night lights and other L1-L3 land, atmosphere and ocean products, searchable by tile and date. Earthdata Login token for downloads.

sources.name: NASA LANCE (Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for EOS)
sources.description: Near-real-time (typically under 3 hours) MODIS, VIIRS, OMI, AIRS, MLS, AMSR2, ATMS and other products for applications. Earthdata Login is needed for download.

sources.name: NASA LP DAAC (Land Processes DAAC at USGS EROS)
sources.description: Land products: MODIS/VIIRS land, ASTER L1T/GDEM, HLS, NASADEM, SRTM, ECOSTRESS, EMIT, GEDI and Landsat-derived MEaSUREs. Data via Earthdata Search or LP DAAC data pool; login required.

sources.name: NISAR (NASA-ISRO SAR) data
sources.description: L- and S-band SAR mission launched 30 July 2025 with free, open data; L1 to L3 products (RSLC, GSLC, GCOV, GUNW) delivered via ASF DAAC and Earthdata Cloud in HDF5/GeoTIFF. Check the portal for current production status.

sources.name: NSIDC data portal (DAAC and non-DAAC collections)
sources.provider: National Snow and Ice Data Center, CU Boulder
sources.description: NASA DAAC for snow, ice, glaciers, permafrost and frozen ground, plus non-DAAC NSF/NOAA cryosphere collections. Downloads of NASA-held data need a free Earthdata Login; many collections are also discoverable through NASA CMR.

sources.name: NASA Ocean Color Web
sources.description: Archive and browser for ocean-color and SST missions (SeaWiFS, MODIS Aqua/Terra, VIIRS, OCTS, CZCS, PACE, Landsat). L1-L3 NetCDF products; free Earthdata login for download and Level-3 mapped images.

links.label: NASA OB.DAAC (Ocean Biology Distributed Active Archive Center)

sources.name: NASA OPERA (Observational Products for End-Users from Remote Sensing Analysis)
sources.description: Analysis-ready surface-water, disturbance, Sentinel-1 RTC and CSLC, DSWx-HLS/S1 and displacement products generated from Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat. Open-access via ASF and LP DAAC; Earthdata Login required.

sources.name: NASA ORNL DAAC (Oak Ridge National Laboratory DAAC)
sources.description: DAAC for biogeochemical dynamics: field campaigns, airborne imagery (AVIRIS, LVIS), MODIS subsets, Daymet, ABoVE and ecosystem products. Many datasets open GeoTIFF/NetCDF; Earthdata Login for download.

sources.name: NASA PACE (Plankton, Aerosol, Cloud, ocean Ecosystem)
sources.description: Hyperspectral ocean colour mission launched Feb 2024 (OCI 340-890 nm plus SWIR bands, HARP2, SPEXone polarimeters). Data via OB.DAAC; Earthdata Login for download.

sources.name: NASA PO.DAAC (Physical Oceanography DAAC)
sources.description: Sea surface temperature (MUR, GHRSST), sea surface height (Jason, SWOT, Sentinel-6), salinity (SMAP, Aquarius), winds (QuikSCAT, ASCAT, CYGNSS) and gravity (GRACE). NetCDF with OPeNDAP, PODAAC Drive and cloud access; Earthdata Login for download.

sources.name: NASA SEDAC (Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center)
sources.description: Gridded population, settlements, urban extent, infrastructure, poverty and hazard data, including GPW, GRUMP and night-lights-derived products; mostly GeoTIFF/NetCDF rasters. Earthdata Login for downloads.

sources.name: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio
sources.description: Collection of NASA science animations, still renders and data visualizations, with downloadable frames and source data for some items. Derived visuals, useful for context but not raw data.

sources.name: NASA SWOT mission data (Surface Water and Ocean Topography)
sources.description: Wide-swath Ka-band radar interferometer measuring ocean and inland-water surface height at ~2 km (ocean) and ~100 m (hydrology) since 2022. Products via PO.DAAC/AVISO; Earthdata Login required.

sources.name: NASA UAVSAR airborne L-band SAR
sources.description: L-band polarimetric repeat-pass SAR from NASA's Gulfstream-III (and P-band, Ka-band), 2008-present, for InSAR, cryosphere and ecology. Data in ASF and via the UAVSAR site; Earthdata Login for download.

sources.name: NASA Worldview
sources.description: Interactive viewer of 1000+ near-real-time and historical satellite layers (MODIS, VIIRS, Landsat HLS, GOES, Himawari, OMI, AIRS) with comparison tools and image snapshots. Backed by GIBS; no login to browse, Earthdata login for granule downloads.

sources.name: NICT Science Cloud Himawari Real-time Web
sources.description: Japan NICT Himawari-8/9 full-disk imagery viewer and Science Cloud archive (2015-present) with FTP/HTTP access. Free registration required for bulk data.

sources.name: PDOK (Dutch national geo-data portal)
sources.description: Dutch open geodata: aerial orthophotos (Luchtfoto, 8 cm and 25 cm), AHN lidar height model (0.5 m), BRT maps and satellite basemaps, via WMS, WMTS, WCS, ATOM and OGC API. No login.

sources.name: Hoydedata (Norway national elevation) and Norge i bilder
sources.description: Norway's lidar-based DTM/DSM (0.25-10 m), point clouds and national aerial imagery (Norge i bilder) with historical orthophotos. Open (CC BY 4.0), free downloads after login-free selection.

sources.name: NOAA CLASS (Comprehensive Large Array-data Stewardship System)
sources.description: NOAA's long-term archive for POES AVHRR, GOES, JPSS VIIRS/ATMS, Metop and DMSP data with order-based retrieval. Free account required for orders.

sources.name: NOAA CoastWatch / OceanWatch
sources.description: Ocean and coastal satellite products: SST, chlorophyll, ocean colour, sea ice, winds, ocean altimetry with ERDDAP servers and regional nodes (West Coast, Great Lakes, Gulf). Open.

sources.name: NOAA Digital Coast
sources.description: Coastal lidar, topobathy elevation, high-resolution imagery, land cover (C-CAP) and sea-level-rise layers; Data Access Viewer for custom orders, with open S3 hosting of lidar. Free.

sources.name: NOAA/Colorado School of Mines Earth Observation Group night lights
sources.provider: Colorado School of Mines EOG / NOAA
sources.description: VIIRS Nighttime Lights annual and monthly composites (2012-present) and DMSP-OLS stable lights (1992-2013), plus VIIRS Nightfire flare detections. Annual downloads require free EOG registration.

sources.name: GOES-R Series (GOES-16/18/19) ABI imagery
sources.description: Geostationary Advanced Baseline Imager, 16 bands 0.47-13.3 microns, full disk every 10 min, 0.5-2 km; plus GLM lightning and space-weather instruments. Open on AWS/GCP; CLASS for archive.

sources.name: NOAA NCEI Bathymetric Data Viewer and DEMs
sources.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
sources.description: Search and download multibeam, lidar bathymetry, and coastal relief/DEM grids (e.g., coastal relief, ETOPO 2022) covering US and global seafloor and land elevation. Open, no login.

sources.name: NOAA NCEI satellite data
sources.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
sources.description: NCEI portal to satellite-based climate data records and archives: AVHRR CDR, GridSat, ISCCP, SST/OISST, DMSP-OLS nightlights, Nighttime Lights and Geostationary data. Open HTTPS/THREDDS access.

sources.name: NOAA National Geodetic Survey Emergency Response Imagery
sources.description: Post-hazard (hurricane, flood, tornado) aerial imagery acquired by NOAA Remote Sensing Division, plus historical Coast Survey archive. Free viewing, tiled WMS and full-resolution download.

sources.name: NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD) on AWS/GCP/Azure
sources.description: Cloud-hosted open copies of NOAA satellite and other data (GOES-16/18/19 ABI/GLM, JPSS VIIRS/ATMS/CrIS, NOAA-20/21, NEXRAD, HRRR) via public S3/GCS/Azure buckets with no login.

sources.name: NOAA OSPO Satellite Products
sources.description: Operational satellite products from NOAA, Himawari, Meteosat and others: sea ice, snow, fire and smoke, volcanic ash, SST, OLR. Imagery pages and FTP product files; open.

sources.name: NOAA STAR GOES Image Viewer
sources.provider: NOAA NESDIS Center for Satellite Applications and Research (STAR)
sources.description: Real-time and archived GOES-East/West ABI imagery in full-disk, CONUS, sectors, GeoColor and all bands with animations and full-resolution downloads. No login.

sources.name: NOAA STAR JPSS (VIIRS) products
sources.description: Imagery and products from VIIRS, ATMS, CrIS and OMPS on NOAA-20/21 and Suomi NPP including true colour, sea ice, fire and ocean colour. Browse and downloadable L1-L2 files; open.

sources.name: LINZ Data Service and Basemaps (New Zealand)
sources.description: New Zealand national aerial imagery (7.5-30 cm), lidar-derived DEM/DSM and historic imagery; open data via AWS S3 STAC at Open Data Registry and the LINZ Basemaps viewer. CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: Geoportal Krajowy (Poland) - orthophotomap and LiDAR (GUGiK)
sources.provider: Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography (GUGiK)
sources.description: Poland's national geoportal with orthophotomap (10-25 cm), airborne laser scanning point clouds and NMT/NMPT elevation under open licence; WMS/WMTS and downloads through the Open Data portal.

sources.name: Roscosmos Geoportal (Russian Earth remote sensing)
sources.provider: Roscosmos / Scientific Center for Operative Earth Monitoring (NTs OMZ)
sources.description: Russian Federation's geoportal for Resurs-P, Kanopus-V, Meteor-M and Electro-L Earth imagery with catalogue and viewer; Russian interface, registration required and access largely for Russian users.

sources.name: Electro-L and Meteor-M imagery (NTs OMZ / ISDC)
sources.description: Russian state centre for reception, archiving and distribution of hydrometeorological satellite data (Elektro-L geostationary, Meteor-M polar series). Provides imagery and derived products; public quicklooks exist but archive access may require registration. Russian-language.

sources.name: Lantmateriet open geodata (Sweden) - orthophotos, Laserdata, elevation
sources.description: Sweden's open geodata: orthophoto (Ortofoto), national lidar (Laserdata), Markhojdmodell 1 m / 50 m DEM, and historical aerial photography. Open since 2021 via download and WMS/WMTS/STAC; some APIs require registration.

sources.name: Sentinel Hub EO Browser
sources.description: Browser viewer for Sentinel-1/2/3/5P, Landsat 8/9, MODIS, Copernicus DEM and commercial collections with custom band scripts, time-lapse and downloads. Public browsing is free; full-resolution downloads and some collections need a Sentinel Hub account.

sources.name: GISTDA Thailand - THEOS-2 and Sphere platform
sources.provider: Geo-Informatics and Space Technology Development Agency (GISTDA)
sources.description: Thai agency distributing THEOS and THEOS-2 imagery, flood, drought and burned-area products and the Sphere geospatial platform. Basic product maps open; imagery usually by request.

sources.name: CEDA Archive (Centre for Environmental Data Analysis)
sources.description: UK national archive of atmospheric and Earth observation data: ESA CCI, Sentinel, MODIS, Landsat, airborne ARSF imagery (Eagle/Hawk hyperspectral, lidar), NEODAAS. Many datasets open, others need CEDA account; THREDDS/OPeNDAP.

sources.name: DataMapWales / Lle Geo-Portal for Wales LiDAR and aerial
sources.description: Open lidar composite DTM/DSM (1 m, 2 m), aerial imagery and Welsh geospatial datasets; available through Lle and DataMapWales under OGL.

sources.name: UK Defra Data Services Platform (national LiDAR and Survey Open Data)
sources.description: National LiDAR Programme and composite DTM/DSM (25 cm-2 m) for England, plus Vertical Aerial Photography; open under Open Government Licence. Download tiles by map, no login.

sources.name: UK NERC Airborne Research Facility (ARSF) / NEODAAS data
sources.provider: NERC Earth Observation Data Acquisition and Analysis Service (NEODAAS)
sources.description: UK NERC EO data service with free satellite imagery (MODIS, AVHRR, Sentinel, VIIRS) for marine and land, plus airborne hyperspectral and lidar data archives. Free account; some data restricted to NERC grants.

sources.name: Scotland's Remote Sensing Portal (Phase 1-6 LiDAR, DTM, DSM)
sources.description: Open Scottish aerial lidar (Phase 1-6, 2012-2022), DTM/DSM at 0.25-1 m and point clouds, plus Sentinel and aerial imagery; open under Open Government Licence. Map-based selector, no login.

sources.name: NASA Black Marble (VNP46) night-time lights
sources.provider: NASA Goddard (Roman et al.) / LAADS DAAC
sources.description: Daily, monthly and annual VIIRS night-lights products (VNP46A1-A4), corrected for moonlight and atmosphere at 500 m. Distributed via LAADS DAAC with Earthdata Login; global viewer open.

sources.name: NASADEM
sources.description: Reprocessed SRTM 1 arc-second (30 m) global elevation model between 60N and 56S with improved void filling using ASTER GDEM and ICESat. Download via Earthdata Search or AWS (free Earthdata login).

sources.name: OpenTopography
sources.description: Portal for high-resolution topography: airborne and terrestrial lidar point clouds, global DEMs (SRTM, ALOS, Copernicus GLO-30, NASADEM, ASTER, GEDI) and derivatives, with an API. Free account needed for large downloads and API key.

sources.name: USDA NAIP (National Agriculture Imagery Program)
sources.provider: USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, Geospatial Enterprise Operations
sources.description: 1 m (and 0.3-0.6 m recent) 4-band (RGB+NIR) aerial orthoimagery of the contiguous US every 2-3 years since 2003, public domain. Available through EarthExplorer, USGS, AWS (requester-pays), Planetary Computer STAC and Google Earth Engine.

sources.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP)
sources.description: National elevation program for the US with lidar-derived DEMs at 1 m, 1/3 and 1 arc-second, plus lidar point clouds, via The National Map and AWS. Free, no login.

sources.name: USGS Declassified Satellite Imagery - CORONA, ARGON, LANYARD (1 and 2)
sources.description: Declassified US reconnaissance film imagery 1960-1972 (KH-1 to KH-4B; 2-8 m resolution), scanned and searchable in EarthExplorer. Free; scanned film as TIFF with login for full-resolution download.

sources.name: USGS EarthExplorer
sources.description: Main USGS search-and-download portal for Landsat, Sentinel, ASTER, MODIS, SRTM, NAIP, NHAP/NAPP aerial photography, declassified satellite photos, DEMs and more. Free account needed to download; M2M API provides programmatic access.

sources.name: USGS EROS aerial photography archives (NHAP, NAPP, AMS, DOQ)
sources.description: Scanned US aerial photography archives: Aerial Mapping Service, NHAP (1980-89), NAPP (1987-2007) and digital orthophoto quadrangles (DOQ). Browse and download in EarthExplorer with a free account.

sources.name: USGS GloVis
sources.description: Browser-based viewer to preview and order Landsat, Sentinel-2, ASTER, MODIS and other scenes by quick-look browse in sequence. Account needed for download.

sources.name: Landsat Collection 2 (Level-1 and Level-2)
sources.description: Global Landsat 1-9 archive from 1972 (MSS, TM, ETM+, OLI/TIRS) reprocessed to Collection 2 with Level-1 and Level-2 surface reflectance/temperature. 15-100 m; free via EarthExplorer, LandsatLook, AWS and Google; cloud access is requester-pays on AWS.

sources.name: USGS LandsatLook
sources.description: USGS viewer and STAC API for Landsat Collection 2 scenes, with quick previews, band combinations and links to full COG downloads (also on AWS). No login for browsing.

sources.name: USGS EROS Machine-to-Machine (M2M) API
sources.description: JSON API for searching and ordering/downloading everything in EarthExplorer scripted. Requires an EROS account and M2M access approval.

sources.name: MRLC National Land Cover Database (NLCD) and Annual NLCD
sources.description: 30 m Landsat-derived US land cover, tree canopy cover and impervious surface products (1985-2023 annual), with viewers, downloads and WMS. Open, no login.

sources.name: USGS The National Map (TNM Download and Viewer)
sources.description: Downloader and viewer for US topographic base data: 3DEP elevation, NAIP and historical orthoimagery, National Hydrography, topographic maps (US Topo, historical topo). Open, no login; TNM Access REST API available.

sources.name: SRTM 1 arc-second global DEM (USGS)
sources.description: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (Feb 2000) global 30 m DEM between 60N-56S, distributed as 1x1 degree tiles via EarthExplorer. Open with free account; also available through LP DAAC as NASADEM.
